extends: v3: splits/v3.json, unchanged (and v1, v2 through it)

slices.round2_train: round 2 group A, less the calibration sets: training
slices.round2_calib: round 2 group A sets in scenarios/round2/calibration.json (fixed before any run): temperature fitting and model selection, never trained on
slices.round2_test: round 2 group B, held out whole: evaluation only; never used for training, calibration or model selection, never pooled with other test slices

rule: a call takes the slice of the fixture set its run used (run.json fixture_set); build_split refuses round2_test gold; use_allowed() gives each slice's permitted uses; spangloss.eval.split check-sets
frozen: 2026-11-17, before any round-2 group B run that counts (the two group-B pilot runs predate the G2 rebuild and are discarded)
